name: Proton VPN
author: loneycoffee
description: A shield on the bar for the official Proton VPN CLI: connect to the fastest server, a favorite country, a city, a server ID, Secure Core, P2P or Tor; see the server, its load and your exit IP; switch NetShield and the kill switch. Right click connects or disconnects. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle proton-vpn

barWidget.description: Proton VPN status and quick connect

schema.label: Right-click connects to (country code, city or server ID; empty for fastest)
